records.explanation: In the "shorter subtitle" test, conversion rates were 42.6% and 42.4%, a z-score of 0.31, which is well under the 1.96 needed for 95% significance.
records.sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT e.experiment_id, e.experiment_name, d.variant, SUM(d.taps) AS taps, SUM(d.installs) AS installs
  FROM reporting.experiments e
  JOIN reporting.experiment_daily d ON d.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
  WHERE e.experiment_name ILIKE '%subtitle%'
  GROUP BY e.experiment_id, e.experiment_name, d.variant
), pr AS (
  SELECT a.experiment_id, a.experiment_name,
         a.variant AS variant_a, b.variant AS variant_b,
         a.taps AS taps_a, a.installs AS installs_a,
         b.taps AS taps_b, b.installs AS installs_b,
         a.installs::numeric / a.taps AS cr_a,
         b.installs::numeric / b.taps AS cr_b,
         (a.installs + b.installs)::numeric / (a.taps + b.taps) AS p,
         a.taps AS na, b.taps AS nb
  FROM v a JOIN v b ON a.experiment_id = b.experiment_id AND a.variant < b.variant
)
SELECT experiment_id, experiment_name, variant_a, variant_b, taps_a, installs_a, taps_b, installs_b, cr_a, cr_b,
       (cr_a - cr_b) / sqrt(p * (1 - p) * (1.0 / na + 1.0 / nb)) AS z_score,
       abs((cr_a - cr_b) / sqrt(p * (1 - p) * (1.0 / na + 1.0 / nb))) > 1.96 AS significant_at_95
FROM pr;
